Name: Mashkolai Dal Peeled 500 gm
LongDescription: Mashkolai Dal Peeled is a type of lentil commonly known as Black Mash Dal (or Black Gram Lentils). These lentils are peeled to remove their outer skin, making them soft and easy to cook. Mashkolai Dal is a rich source of protein, fiber, and essential nutrients, and it is a staple in many South Asian cuisines.
